name: Nikolaj
site: dsb.dk · Rail tickets and timetables, Denmark
headline: Turn DSB’s booking data into journeys that stay with you.
saw: Your homepage sells train tickets, fares and passes, from commuter cards and youth tickets to travel abroad, and every visitor sees the same page whether they commute daily or travel rarely.

Once a passenger uses your app or logs in, which routes they search, when they buy and which tickets they never use is your strongest signal. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the passenger receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The commuter on a pass who is about to stop travelling this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per passenger, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Lapse signals per passenger from booking gaps, app use and timetable searches. The right offer, channel and moment, chosen for each traveller and tested in the DSB-appen and by email.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Sell the right ticket to each traveller
cases.text: Next best ticket or add-on per passenger, triggered by the routes they actually take. No more blanket mails to people who already hold the right product.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep the DSB-appen in use every week
cases.text: Personal route, timetable and disruption nudges in the app, push and email, so every passenger has a reason to open DSB again between journeys.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
